title: Grothendieck derived Brown right adjoint
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], D(A) its ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and T a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category]. An exact functor F : D(A) → T that preserves arbitrary set-indexed coproducts admits a right adjoint. Coproducts and Hom sets are understood in a common indexing universe; no compact generation of D(A), boundedness, or geometric hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Install the standard opposite shifts, pretriangulated structures, and opposite exactness of F as local instances within the proof. For each Y, form H = F.op ⋙ preadditiveYoneda.obj Y. Mathlib homologicality of preadditiveYoneda and exactness of F.op give H.IsHomological. For each discrete indexing category, convert hF to coproduct preservation for the opposite discrete category and hence product preservation by F.op. Yoneda preserves limits; the additive-group forgetful functor reflects them, so preadditiveYoneda preserves products. Composition gives the product-preservation hypothesis for H. These steps are implemented by Mathlib instances and preservesColimitsOfShape_of_equiv, preservesLimitsOfShape_op, and preservesLimitsOfShape_of_reflects_of_preserves.

Apply the cohomological Grothendieck-derived Brown theorem to H with its proven homologicality and product-preservation hypotheses. Its conclusion is definitionally (F.op ⋙ yoneda.obj Y).IsRepresentable.

Thus every object is in F.rightAdjointObjIsDefined. Function extensionality and propositional extensionality identify this property with top. Apply Mathlib Functor.isLeftAdjoint_of_rightAdjointObjIsDefined_eq_top, which constructs the adjoint from the objectwise representing natural bijections by Yoneda.

theorem grothendieckDerived_hasRightAdjoint
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    {D : Type uD} [Category.{vD} D] [HasZeroObject D] [HasShift D ℤ]
    [Preadditive D]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor D n).Additive]
    [Pretriangulated D] [IsTriangulated D]
    [HasCoproducts.{max w vA vD} D]
    (F : DerivedCategory A ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    [HasCoproducts.{max w vA vD} (DerivedCategory A)]
    (hF : ∀ I : Type (max w vA vD),
      PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) F) :
    F.IsLeftAdjoint
